name: open-webui
description: (Formerly Ollama WebUI) ChatGPT-Style Web Interface for various LLM runners, including Ollama and OpenAI-compatible APIs IMPORTANT: Make sure to add the following environment variable to your ollama container - OLLAMA_ORIGINS=* Set your OpenAI API key (not persistant) - OPENAI_API_KEY

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Sets the port to run Open WebUI from.

variables.name: WEBUI_SECRET_KEY
variables.description: You MUST set WEBUI_SECRET_KEY to a secure, persistent value. Example command: openssl rand -base64 48

variables.name: ENABLE_OLLAMA_API
variables.description: Enables the use of Ollama APIs.

variables.name: OLLAMA_BASE_URL
variables.description: Configures the Ollama backend URL.

variables.name: ENABLE_OPENAI_API
variables.description: Enables the use of OpenAI APIs.

variables.name: OPENAI_API_BASE_URL
variables.description: Configures the OpenAI base API URL.

variables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
variables.description: Sets the OpenAI API key, e.g. sk-124781258123.

variables.name: WEBUI_AUTH
variables.description: This setting enables or disables authentication.

variables.name: CORS_ALLOW_ORIGIN
variables.description: Sets the allowed origins for Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS). Smicolon ';' separated list of allowed origins.

variables.name: ENABLE_CHANNELS
variables.description: Enables or disables channel support.

variables.name: ENABLE_FOLDERS
variables.description: Enables or disables the folders feature, allowing users to organize their chats into folders in the sidebar.

variables.name: ENABLE_NOTES
variables.description: Enables or disables the notes feature, allowing users to create and manage personal notes within Open WebUI.

variables.name: ENABLE_MEMORIES
variables.description: Enables or disables the memory feature, allowing models to store and retrieve long-term information about users.

variables.name: ENABLE_ADMIN_CHAT_ACCESS
variables.description: Enables admin users to directly access the chats of other users.

variables.name: ENABLE_ADMIN_ANALYTICS
variables.description: Controls whether the Analytics tab is visible and accessible in the admin panel.

variables.name: ENABLE_EASTER_EGGS
variables.description: Enables or disables easter egg features in the UI, such as special themes. Set to False to hide these optional novelty features from users.

variables.name: GLOBAL_LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Sets the global logging level for all Open WebUI components.

variables.name: ENABLE_EVALUATION_ARENA_MODELS
variables.description: Enables or disables evaluation arena models.

variables.name: ENABLE_MESSAGE_RATING
variables.description: Enables message rating feature.

variables.name: ENABLE_COMMUNITY_SHARING
variables.description: Controls whether users can share content with the Open WebUI Community and access community resources.

variables.name: HTTP_PROXY
variables.description: Proxy for HTTP.

variables.name: HTTPS_PROXY
variables.description: Proxy for HTTPS.

variables.name: NO_PROXY
variables.description: Comma-separate list of hosts/IPs that bypass the proxy.
